query:
The Ridge and Trail Collective operates with a norm that everyone carries a full personal first aid kit and a foil emergency blanket on every outing. Does this apply to all members equally? If not, who has a different pattern and what does the conversation show?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Kwame
C. Saoirse
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Dmitri, episodic, t4 @2025-10-05T16:28:00) Group PLB is packed. But yes, personal kit always useful.
[2] (about=Kwame, episodic, t18 @2025-11-23T16:14:00) I have confirmed with myself that I will read the full kit list this time and action every item individually. checklist on phone, bag packed by Friday. Dmitri can you just check my bag before we set off anyway in case I missed something 😅
[3] (about=Nadia, core, t10 @2025-10-26T14:47:00) Sending kit list now; advises not to buy expensive sleeping bag, borrow first to see temperature rating needed.
[4] (about=Saoirse, core, t22 @2025-12-07T16:02:00) Bothy medical kit used once: minor blister on day two. Good result for nine people over two days.
agent_answer:
The norm does **not** apply equally to everyone.

**Kwame (B)** shows a different pattern. He says:  
> "I have confirmed with myself that I will read the full kit list **this time** and action every item individually... Dmitri can you just check my bag before we set off anyway in case I missed something 😅"

This implies he previously did **not** fully follow the full personal kit routine, and now needs to be checked against the full list.

The others mentioned do not show a different pattern in the material: Dmitri agrees the personal kit is useful, Nadia sends the kit list, and Saoirse refers to a group bothy medical kit — none indicate a deviation.
